svg.aria-label: VacancyChains.jl logo: three stacked positions with a vacancy at the top and a chain of moves cascading upward.
svg.title: VacancyChains.jl
svg.desc: Three vertically stacked position boxes outlined in Julia blue. The top box is dashed and empty, representing a vacancy. The middle box contains a Julia-red filled circle and the bottom box a Julia-green filled circle, representing two persons. Two upward arrows in Julia purple on the right side show the chain of moves filling the vacancy.
